title: motion-pack project file
description: ONE file a person or an agent edits to make a video from any motion-pack template. Each template's config.mjs exports PROJECT_MAP, which maps the fields below onto its own CONFIG paths; templates/_shared/project.mjs validates this file against this schema, applies the map, then applies --set key=value on top. Keys that start with // are comments and are ignored everywhere. Paths (media src, logo, voice) are relative to the project file. A digit in on-screen copy (text.*, brand.cta, brand.line) needs a claim with a real source.

$schema.description: optional pointer to this schema, for editors

template.description: the template id this project builds by default (templates/<id>), or a list of ids it drives (the first one is the default). `mp list` shows them.

name.description: the product or brand name shown in frame (a fictional brand in demos, labelled)

accent.description: the ONE brand colour (accent words, buttons, the hero mark). `mp brand logo.svg` suggests one and checks its contrast

ink.description: text colour on paper (needs 4.5:1 against paper)

paper.description: background colour of cards and end cards

logo.description: path to YOUR logo (SVG or PNG), or null for none. Never a third-party mark

url.description: the URL on the end card, e.g. orbit.example

cta.description: the call to action on the end card (a digit needs a claim with a source)

line.description: an end line / tagline (optional; a digit needs a claim with a source)

display.description: display family (shipped: Manrope, IBM Plex Mono, STIX Two Text)

text.description: ALL on-screen copy, keyed. Shared vocabulary (a template maps the keys it uses; `mp list` shows them): headline (the hook or claim line, at most 7 words, one *accent* word), subline, problem (a list of short lines), product, benefit, end, intro, promise, name, title, words (a list), availability. A key the chosen template does not use is reported, not silently dropped.

media.description: named footage / screenshot slots. src null = the template renders a labelled pack placeholder ('placeholder' in frame).

words.description: word timings: a words.json ([{w, s, e}] or {words: [...]}) or an .srt file (each cue's words are spread evenly over the cue: approximate)

music.description: a pack music id (music/manifest.json), e.g. music/bed_tech_pulse_loop8; null = no bed

length.description: a length in seconds or a named cut, for templates that have one (the ad: 15 | 30)

platforms.description: where it will be posted, as pack platform presets (templates/_shared/plan.mjs PLATFORMS). For each aspect the first preset of that shape sets the safe zone and brand-cue deadline.

aspects.description: the aspects to deliver. Each is a RE-LAYOUT, never a crop; `mp list` shows which aspects each template supports (native, generic re-layout, or manual).

claims.description: every claim the video makes. A claim whose text contains a digit needs a `source` that says where the number comes from (lint.proof; 'internal benchmark' and other generic sources are refused). `key` ties a claim to the copy it backs (e.g. text.headline).

source.description: where the number comes from (a document, a measurement, a URL)

method.description: how it was measured (proof-style templates require it next to the source)

overrides.description: raw CONFIG values per template id, for anything the shared fields do not cover: {"ad": {"length": 30}}. Applied after the map and before --set. Unknown CONFIG paths are an error.

src.description: path to YOUR footage or screenshot (relative to the project file), or null for a labelled placeholder

start.description: seconds into the source where the slot starts

label.description: what belongs in the slot; printed on the placeholder until src is set
